- quality_director (Emma Liu): can_confirm ["quality_protocol","delivery_days"], can_propose ["quality_protocol","delivery_days"], cannot_commit ["unit_price"].

Thus Emma can propose/confirm quality protocol and delivery days, but cannot commit unit price.

- supplier_ceo (Mr. Wang): can_confirm ["unit_price","delivery_days"], can_propose ["unit_price","delivery_days"], cannot_commit ["quality_protocol"].

Thus Wang can propose/confirm unit price and delivery days, but cannot commit quality protocol.

- user (Alex Chen): can_confirm ["delivery_days","quality_protocol","unit_price"], can_propose ["delivery_days","quality_protocol","unit_price"].
